customer_message.subject: Request for assistance: defective heating in my rented flat, Rosenstrasse 24, Olten
customer_message.body: Dear Claims Team, I am writing to request help with a defect in my rented flat at Rosenstrasse 24, Olten, a 4-room flat rented from Verwaltung Rhein & Partner. The heating does not work properly. Several rooms stay cold, radiators fail, and the flat cools down to about 16 degrees. I reported the problem to the landlord several times, but it has not been fixed. I have copies of my messages. A member of my household has had repeated colds and bronchitis, which I attribute to the cold flat. I am not sure what is causing the failure. A technical expert inspection by a building or heating specialist is needed to establish the cause. We have not yet arranged one, and I do not know whether the landlord will agree. Could you advise me on my options and whether your policy covers the costs of the expert and of legal advice? I would appreciate a reply within two weeks. Kind regards, Casey Hughes
